solved_invariants: ExtremeGC now records stable inventory fingerprints plus expected and observed yield bytes.
Inventory below the default 0.01 GiB maintenance floor enters bounded exponential backoff from 15 minutes to 6 hours.
The supervisor consults durable yield state before spawning another inventory subprocess.
A two-call 4 MiB replay produced yield_exhausted then yield_backoff, retained the residual, did not rewrite inventory, and wrote zero deletion proofs.
The complete ControlPlane suite and Architecture Atlas remain green.
body.summary: Implemented yield-aware ExtremeGC metabolism. Roughly 0.004 GiB of regenerated inventory is now fingerprinted, accounted, retained, and cooled instead of repeatedly scanned and proof-written. Material pressure, fingerprint changes, expiry, and the emergency floor safely reopen maintenance.

tests.command: Disposable 4 MiB ExtremeGC two-call integration replay
tests.result: First call expected 4,194,304 bytes and entered yield_exhausted; second call was an inventory cache hit with no inventory rewrite or proof write.
Supervisor skipped reclaim with expected_yield_bytes=4,194,304 and inventory_cache_hit=true.
Valid: 195 architectures, 11 views, 59 interactions, 14 phenotypes, 16 edge classes.
